name: edit_template
description: Update listing fields (name, description, price, preview/video/payment urls, tags) on a template YOU published to 21st.dev. Owner-only - the id must belong to the signed-in caller (404 otherwise). Provide at least one field. `tagIds`, when provided, REPLACES the full tag set. Does NOT accept a live/status toggle - non-admin authors change that through moderation review, not this tool.

paymentUrl.description: Off-site buy links are off: only null (clear) is accepted.

tagIds.description: Tag ids - REPLACES the full tag set.
